metadata.question: Was the concentration of tropospheric nitrogen dioxide over Brooklyn, New York lower between October 1-23, 2021 compared to the same period in 2019 and 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-5P TROPOMI data for tropospheric NO2 concentration - Collection: "COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI_L3_NO2" - Date ranges: Oct 1-23, 2021 vs Oct 1-23, 2019 vs Oct 1-23, 2018 - Location: Brooklyn, New York (approximate bounds: -74.04, 40.65, -73.88, 40.72) - Need to compare mean NO2 concentrations across three years 2. Masking strategy: - TROPOMI has a quality assurance value; filter for QA > 0.75 to ensure good retrievals - No cloud masking needed as TROPOMI is a spectrometer that observes through clouds - Use the "NO2_column_number_density" band 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs Null/Error (C3): - Check if each year's collection has images (.size().getInfo() > 0) - If collection empty, try to recover (widen date range slightly) or output C1 - Check pixel counts after QA filtering; if 0, output C2 - If mean NO2 is None/NaN or physically unreasonable (negative), output C3 - Valid answer: if 2021 NO2 < 2019 AND 2021 NO2 < 2018, output A; otherwise B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Brooklyn, New York geometry const brooklyn = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-74.04, 40.65, -73.88, 40.72]); // Function to get mean NO2 for a date range and year async function getMeanNO2(year, startDay, endDay) { const startDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 10, startDay); const endDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 10, endDay); const collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI_L3_NO2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(brooklyn) .filter(ee.Filter.gte('qa_value', 0.75)); const size = collection.size().getInfo(); if (size === 0) { console.log(`${year}: No images found (size: 0)`); return { mean: null, count: 0, size: size }; } const meanImage = collection.mean(); const stats = meanImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: brooklyn, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const meanValue = stats.get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); const countStats = collection.first().reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: brooklyn, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const pixelCount = countStats.get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo(); return { mean: meanValue, count: pixelCount, size: size }; } // Get data for each year const result2021 = await getMeanNO2(2021, 1, 23); const result2019 = await getMeanNO2(2019, 1, 23); const result2018 = await getMeanNO2(2018, 1, 23); console.log(`2021 Oct 1-23: ${result2021.size} images, Mean NO2: ${result2021.mean}, Pixels: ${result2021.count}`); console.log(`2019 Oct 1-23: ${result2019.size} images, Mean NO2: ${result2019.mean}, Pixels: ${result2019.count}`); console.log(`2018 Oct 1-23: ${result2018.size} images, Mean NO2: ${result2018.mean}, Pixels: ${result2018.count}`); // Check for empty collections if (result2021.size === 0 || result2019.size === 0 || result2018.size === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } // Check for no valid pixels if (result2021.count === 0 || result2019.count === 0 || result2018.count === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } // Check for invalid/null values if (result2021.mean === null || result2019.mean === null || result2018.mean === null || isNaN(result2021.mean) || isNaN(result2019.mean) || isNaN(result2018.mean) || result2021.mean < 0 || result2019.mean < 0 || result2018.mean < 0) { console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare: Is 2021 lower than both 2019 and 2018? const lower2019 = result2021.mean < result2019.mean; const lower2018 = result2021.mean < result2018.mean; console.log(`2021 lower than 2019: ${lower2019}`); console.log(`2021 lower than 2018: ${lower2018}`); if (lower2019 && lower2018) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
